integral_target.source: class Box;event pulse;endclass module top;Box box;int data;initial begin box=new();data=box.pulse;end endmodule

delay.source: class Box;event pulse;endclass module top;Box a,b;initial begin a=new();b=new();a.pulse=#1 b.pulse;end endmodule

packed_select.source: class Box;event pulse;endclass module top;Box box;initial begin box=new();box.pulse[0]=1;end endmodule
